title: agent-harness spec front matter
description: The YAML front matter of a harness spec. Unknown keys are allowed on purpose — they serve as free documentation — but the linter warns about keys close to a known one, because a typo like max_age instead of max_age_h silently disables a check.

harness.description: Display name. Defaults to the spec filename stem.

harness_compat.description: Minimum linter version this spec needs, e.g. '>=0.2'. A spec written for a newer linter warns instead of being silently misread by an older one.

version.description: The spec's own revision. Not interpreted.

artifact_glob.description: Glob for the output to check. ~ and $VARS expand. The newest match by mtime is checked. Omit for an on-demand harness.

golden.description: Glob of known-good artifacts that must ALWAYS pass this spec. Checked in addition to the newest artifact, so a change to the spec or the linter that would break previously-good output fails in CI instead of on the next real run.

optional.description: When true a missing artifact warns rather than fails.

max_age_h.description: Freshness limit in hours. Either a number (fail after N hours) or a two-tier ladder so a slightly late artifact warns before it fails.

min_bytes.description: Fail below this size. Keep it LOW: 'nothing happened this week' is a valid answer, and a floor that punishes an honest empty week teaches the producer to pad.

required_sections.description: Each must appear as a markdown heading (# to ####).

required_markers.description: Each must appear anywhere in the text. Use for footers and non-heading content.

self_eval_min.description: Minimum number of checkbox lines. Counts checked AND unchecked alike — an unchecked box is the system working.

banned_patterns.description: Regexes the artifact must not match. Evaluation is time-bounded; patterns are untrusted input.

reason.description: Shown with the failure. Write it so the producer knows what to do differently.
